note: pg_relation_size is unavailable, so the size is derived from 20M rows times the SUMMED per-column avg_width (8+8+64+32 = 112 bytes). That is 2.24 GB, roughly eleven seconds at 200 MiB/s: NOTICEABLE. Summing matters — one column's width is not a row width, and using avg_width of a single column would have understated this table fourteenfold.
